title: Additional floor area regulations in the Park Avenue Subdistrict
previewText:
Within the Park Avenue Subdistrict, as shown on Map 1 of the Appendix to this Chapter, the floor area ratio regulations of paragraphs (a) and (b) of Section 138-211 are further modified in this Section.

blocks.html: Within the Park Avenue Subdistrict, as shown on Map 1 of the Appendix to this Chapter, the floor area ratio regulations of paragraphs (a) and (b) of Section 138-211 are further modified in this Section.
blocks.plainText: Within the Park Avenue Subdistrict, as shown on Map 1 of the Appendix to this Chapter, the floor area ratio regulations of paragraphs (a) and (b) of Section 138-211 are further modified in this Section.

blocks.html:
(a)        Required non-residential floor area ratio

Where a development or enlargement of a building on a zoning lot, or portion thereof, located within the Park Avenue Subdistrict contains residentia floor area, such zoning lot shall provide a minimum non-residential floor area ratio as set forth below:
blocks.plainText: (a) Required non-residential floor area ratioWhere a development or enlargement of a building on a zoning lot, or portion thereof, located within the Park Avenue Subdistrict contains residentia floor area, such zoning lot shall provide a minimum non-residential floor area ratio as set forth below:

blocks.html: (1)        in M1-6 Districts paired with an R9 District, a minimum non-residential floor area ratio of 1.0 shall be provided;
blocks.plainText: (1) in M1-6 Districts paired with an R9 District, a minimum non-residential floor area ratio of 1.0 shall be provided;

blocks.html: (2)        in C6-4 Districts, and in M1-6 Districts paired with an R10 District whose maximum residential floor area ratio is 10.0, a minimum non-residential floor area ratio of 1.5 shall be provided; and
blocks.plainText: (2) in C6-4 Districts, and in M1-6 Districts paired with an R10 District whose maximum residential floor area ratio is 10.0, a minimum non-residential floor area ratio of 1.5 shall be provided; and

blocks.html: (3)        in M1-6 Districts paired with an R10 District whose maximum residential floor area ratio is 12.0, a minimum non-residential floor area ratio of 1.5 shall be provided.
blocks.plainText: (3) in M1-6 Districts paired with an R10 District whose maximum residential floor area ratio is 12.0, a minimum non-residential floor area ratio of 1.5 shall be provided.

blocks.html:
(b)        Maximum floor area ratio for zoning lots within M1-6 Districts paired with an R9 District

In M1-6 Districts paired with an R9 District, the maximum floor area ratio for any use, or any combination of uses, shall not exceed 8.5.
blocks.plainText: (b) Maximum floor area ratio for zoning lots within M1-6 Districts paired with an R9 DistrictIn M1-6 Districts paired with an R9 District, the maximum floor area ratio for any use, or any combination of uses, shall not exceed 8.5.

blocks.html:
(c)        Modified maximum floor area ratio for certain zoning lots

The floor area ratios set forth in paragraphs (a) and (b) of this Section, and in Section 138-211, shall be modified, as follows:
blocks.plainText: (c) Modified maximum floor area ratio for certain zoning lotsThe floor area ratios set forth in paragraphs (a) and (b) of this Section, and in Section 138-211, shall be modified, as follows:

blocks.html: (1)        the minimum non-residential floor area requirements set forth in paragraph (a) of this Section shall be optional for zoning lots existing on or before November 30, 2017, with a lot area of less than 5,000 square feet;
blocks.plainText: (1) the minimum non-residential floor area requirements set forth in paragraph (a) of this Section shall be optional for zoning lots existing on or before November 30, 2017, with a lot area of less than 5,000 square feet;

blocks.html: (2)        for zoning lots subject to paragraph (c)(1) of this Section, the maximum floor area ratio for all uses shall be set forth as follows:
blocks.plainText: (2) for zoning lots subject to paragraph (c)(1) of this Section, the maximum floor area ratio for all uses shall be set forth as follows:
